name: "Wind-and-Snowpiercer"
description: The prototype of a new mode of transport, built as part of a plan to bring greater prosperity to the entire nation.\nEvery great idea in the world starts, in most cases, as a small and unremarkable thought.\nJust as the mighty transport engines that will one day charge along the railways were, at the time, no more than tiny models that had been freshly designed and built. But what always matters is the stage that follows — once the model has been proven successful, that is. In this world, Grand plans and enormous dreams have to hatch from within a palm-sized shell before they can begin to run.
